page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7.8xlarge is a general-purpose instance type built on the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The CPU configuration allocates 1.0 thread per core and includes 48 MB of L3 cache, 1 MB of L2 cache, and 48 KB of L1d cache. The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying on external storage options, and delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates average performance across most compute and memory metrics. The instance achieved a single-core stress-ng CPU score of 1829.99 and a multi-core score of 31013.7. In memory bandwidth testing, it recorded 1699.39 GB/sec for cached small-block reads and 153.99 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads. PassMark testing yielded a CPU score of 36598.86 and a memory score of 2775.46, which places its memory performance in the top 25% tier. For language model workloads, the instance processed 135M model text generation at a strong rate of 304.16 tokens/sec, while 7B model text generation operated at an average rate of 18.87 tokens/sec.

The ecs.g7.8xlarge offers a balanced resource density suitable for workloads requiring dedicated CPU allocation without the overhead of hyperthreading. The absence of bundled local storage and GPU hardware makes it a cost-efficient option for standard enterprise workloads that utilize network-attached storage. Based on its benchmark profile, the instance is suited for static web serving, software compilation, database operations, and moderate-scale text processing or language model inference tasks.
